name: sa_bof_nonpagedldapsearch
author: c2biz
comment: Execute non-paged LDAP searches against Active Directory

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: LDAP filter query (e.g., '(objectClass=user)', '(&(objectCategory=person)(sAMAccountName=admin*))')

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to return (e.g., 'sAMAccountName,mail,memberOf'). Omit to return all attributes.

parameters.name: result_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to display. 0 or omit for no limit. Note: server may still truncate at its own limit (e.g., 1000).

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target Domain Controller hostname or IP. Default: auto-discovered via DsGetDcName.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Distinguished Name for search base (e.g., 'DC=corp,DC=local'). Default: current domain DN.

name: sa_bof_netuse_add
author: moloch--
comment: Connect to a network share

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action code (always 1 for add)

parameters.name: share
parameters.description: UNC path to share (e.g., \\server\share)

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Username for authentication (empty for current user)

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for authentication (empty for current user)

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Local device name to map (e.g., Z:). Empty for no mapping.

parameters.name: persist
parameters.description: Make connection persistent across reboots (0=no, 1=yes)

parameters.name: require_privacy
parameters.description: Require SMBv3 encryption, fail if unsupported (0=no, 1=yes)

name: sa_bof_netuse_list
author: moloch--
comment: List network share connections

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action code (always 2 for list)

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Filter by device (e.g., Z:) or share name. Empty to list all.

name: sa_bof_netuse_delete
author: moloch--
comment: Disconnect from a network share

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action code (always 3 for delete)

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Device name (e.g., Z:) or UNC share path to disconnect

parameters.name: persist
parameters.description: Remove persistent mapping so it won't reconnect (0=no, 1=yes)

parameters.name: force_disconnect
parameters.description: Force disconnect even if resources are open (0=no, 1=yes)

name: sa_bof_wmi_query
author: moloch--
comment: Run a WMI query and display results in CSV format

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Target server hostname (default: local machine)

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: WMI namespace (e.g., root\cimv2, root\SecurityCenter2)

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: WQL query to execute (e.g., SELECT * FROM Win32_Process)

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Full WMI resource path (alternative to server+namespace)

name: sa_bof_ldapsearch
author: moloch--
comment: Execute paged LDAP searches against Active Directory

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: LDAP filter query (e.g., '(objectClass=user)', '(&(objectCategory=person)(sAMAccountName=admin*))')

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to return (e.g., 'sAMAccountName,mail,memberOf'). Omit to return all attributes.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 0 (unlimited).

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Search scope: 1=BASE (single object), 2=ONELEVEL (immediate children), 3=SUBTREE (all descendants). Default: 3.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target Domain Controller hostname or IP. Default: auto-discovered PDC.

parameters.name: dn
parameters.description: Distinguished Name for search base (e.g., 'DC=corp,DC=local'). Default: current domain DN.

parameters.name: ldaps
parameters.description: Connection protocol: 1=LDAPS (port 636 with SSL), 0=LDAP (port 389 with signing/sealing). Default: 0.
